article.title: OpenAI Reinstates Five-Hour Usage Limit on Codex and ChatGPT Work for Plus Subscribers
article.summary: OpenAI is bringing back a five-hour usage cap on Codex and ChatGPT Work for Plus subscribers starting August 25, citing compute load management.
article.body_markdown:
## Overview

OpenAI is restoring a five-hour usage limit on Codex and ChatGPT Work for ChatGPT Plus subscribers, effective August 25, 2026, according to [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/). Following several weeks during which Plus users were subject only to a weekly usage cap, [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/) reports that OpenAI announced it is bringing the five-hour window back on top of the existing weekly allowance. [NewsBytes](https://newsbytesapp.com/news/science/openai-brings-back-5-hour-codex-limit-for-chatgpt-plus/story) independently confirms the same August 25 effective date.

## What We Know

Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux, OpenAI's engineering lead for Codex and ChatGPT, announced the change, according to both [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/) and [NewsBytes](https://newsbytesapp.com/news/science/openai-brings-back-5-hour-codex-limit-for-chatgpt-plus/story). [Android Authority](https://www.androidauthority.com/chatgpt-five-hour-limits-3702542/) reports the announcement was made in a post on X.

Explaining the rationale, Sottiaux said, according to [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/), "the 5h limit allows us to smoothen the load on our compute, allowing to keep the plan generous in terms of weekly usage." [Android Authority](https://www.androidauthority.com/chatgpt-five-hour-limits-3702542/) corroborates the compute-management rationale, reporting that reinstating the limit will let OpenAI manage its computing resources more effectively while still offering "generous" weekly limits.

According to [Android Authority](https://www.androidauthority.com/chatgpt-five-hour-limits-3702542/), Sottiaux also framed the change as a way to help Plus subscribers — described as relatively casual and new users — avoid accidentally burning through their entire weekly allowance and being confused about their remaining usage.

Once a user reaches either the five-hour or the weekly limit, they can wait for the next reset cycle or purchase additional credits, [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/) reports. OpenAI also occasionally resets users' limits for free, and banked resets can be earned through certain promotions and referral offers, according to [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/) and confirmed by [NewsBytes](https://newsbytesapp.com/news/science/openai-brings-back-5-hour-codex-limit-for-chatgpt-plus/story).

During the weeks the five-hour limit was lifted, OpenAI reset users' weekly usage early on several occasions to celebrate milestones, including adding another million active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work, which [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/) describes as now-unified platforms; [NewsBytes](https://newsbytesapp.com/news/science/openai-brings-back-5-hour-codex-limit-for-chatgpt-plus/story) reports the same detail. [Android Authority](https://www.androidauthority.com/chatgpt-five-hour-limits-3702542/) reports that the five-hour limits had originally been removed following the release of GPT-5.6.

The reinstated cap applies only to ChatGPT Plus subscribers. Subscribers on the $100 and $200 ChatGPT Pro tiers will not face the five-hour limit and will continue to have only weekly limits on their accounts, according to [Android Authority](https://www.androidauthority.com/chatgpt-five-hour-limits-3702542/), though the outlet reports that Sottiaux's post indicated five-hour limits could be introduced for Pro accounts within a couple of months. [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/) reports that Sottiaux did not mention any changes for Enterprise or Edu accounts, which currently use a separate credit-based usage system.

## What We Don't Know

OpenAI has not published an official help-center or blog post detailing the change independent of Sottiaux's social media post; coverage relies on that announcement as relayed by the outlets cited above. It is not yet confirmed exactly when, or whether, five-hour limits will extend to Pro-tier accounts.
